package: ABS (4-lead gull-wing SMD glass-passivated bridge); LCSC calls it SOP-4
description: YONGYUTAI ABS201 THRU ABS210 single-phase glass-passivated bridge rectifier, 2.0 A / 1000 V. Used as the two external PoE front-end bridges (Mode A across VC1/VC2, Mode B across VC3/VC4) that the LPJG0926HENL magjack does not provide.

land_pattern.package: ABS / ABF, body D 4.9-5.2 x E 4.2-4.5 mm, lead span HE 6.0-6.4 mm, lead pitch d 3.8-4.2 mm, lead width e 0.5-0.7 mm
land_pattern.notes: Pulled land ABF_L5.1-W4.4-P4.00-LS6.2-BL matches the datasheet body/span/pitch on all four dimensions. Its pads run 1.97-3.67 mm from centre, which covers the 0.6 mm foot with ~0.5 mm of heel and ~0.5 mm of toe - more generous than the vendor's own 2.0 x 1.0 mm recommendation, whose toe is 0.1 mm short at maximum lead span.

layout_notes: THERMAL, LOAD-BEARING: the datasheet's RthJA = 65 C/W is quoted 'mounted on glass epoxy PC board with 4 x (5 x 5 mm) copper pad'. The 65 C/W number is only true if the layout gives EACH of the four pads a ~5 x 5 mm copper pour. P7 must honour this or the junction temperature calculation below is void.

Only ONE of the two bridges conducts at a time - 802.3at powers Alternative A or Alternative B, never both - so the energised bridge carries the whole PD current and there is no sharing between packages.

Reverse stress: the rail is 57 V worst case and the SMBJ58A TVS clamps at 93.6 V, so 1000 V VRRM is 10.7x over the clamp. Reverse leakage 5 uA at 25 C / 100 uA at 125 C at the full 1000 V, i.e. far less at 57 V; it does not disturb the detection signature.
The non-energised bridge presents no load: all four of its diodes point INTO the + node and OUT OF the - node, so with its AC inputs floating there is no conducting path between V48_RAW and V48_RTN.
